recipes.name: Creamy Chipotle Chicken
ingredients_raw: salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (8 ounce) package cream cheese, cut into cubes
3 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, minced
1 tablespoon adobo sauce from chipotle peppers

steps.text: Place chicken breasts into a slow cooker, brush with butter, and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and minced garlic. Pour in condensed soup and chicken broth. Add cream cheese, chipotle peppers, and adobo sauce. Stir the mixture gently.
Cover and cook on Low for 6 hours.

raw_recipe.headline: Creamy Chipotle Chicken
raw_recipe.description: An easy, creamy chipotle chicken dish made in the slow cooker gets a smoky kick from the chipotle peppers in adobo sauce. Serve with hot cooked rice.

review.reviewBody: Very similair to a chipotle chicken I have been making for several years. If you really like to cook with chipotles, here's a hint. Puree a can or two of chipotles in adobo. Put in a jar, keep refrigerated & then you can call it "chipotle paste". I add a spoonful to broth when making soups. Also, use this same recipe and instead of chipotles use a basil pesto sauce. Excellent over linguine or fettucine.

Absolutely delicious! Yes, it is spicy, but that can be adjusted to taste. I used bone in chicken thighs. I removed the bones and shredded the chicken after it was done and mixed in some cooked egg noodles the last 15 minutes. Everyone in my house loved this. My son said he wants this recipe when he moves out. This was just as good the next day when rewarmed for leftovers.

Awesome recipe. I implemented some of my own touches. First I pan seared the breast then mixed in everything for the sauce then blended it with a mixer to get rid of the lumps before adding the breast then setting to low for 3 hrs. about in hour in i add about 3/4 cup of sliced thin onions then the last hr i added about 4oz of sliced cramini mushrooms. Deff making this again!

Doubled sauce. I warm cheese & soup in microwave and stir together before pouring over chicken. I add 1 mashed chipotle and 2 tblsp. sauce. I often pre-cook chicken and leave slow cooker on "warm" setting all day when @ work. Family loves this served over rice from Trader Joe's. Could not be easier!

A tasty throw together meal for a busy day!
We found this to be a flavorful, tender and moist dish. As an alternate as suggested, I Halfed the recipe, and chose a 2T pesto base (eliminating the peppers and sauce), then added 1T chopped sundried tomatoes, 1T sliced marinated green olives (at the end) and instead of broth I used boullion powder.
For two generous chicken breasts 3hrs on high was perfect. Upon completion I added a slurry of water and 1T corn starch for a thicker sauce. I served this over pasta. 
We will definitely make this again. 
In addition, we look forward to preparing the chipotle base. The flavor should be outstanding!

Sooooo delicious! I made my own cream of chicken from this site using flour chicken broth and milk and some spices. Make your own if you can it was much better than canned. Also I openly used one big pepper bc I'm a wimp but I used all of the sauce in the jar and it was perfect. Still spicy but not too spicy. I also seasoned the chicken with fajita seasoning and cooked on the stove top then removed the chicken and made the sauce and threw the chicken back in. Also sauteed mushrooms and threw those in there. This is a must try!

Simple creamy spicy comfort food. I did read about the problem many had with the cream cheese separation. I was using my own homemade chicken broth and had to defrost it anyway in the microwave, so I added the cream cheese into it and whisked it until nice and creamy, then poured it into the crock over the chicken. I did use 1/3 less fat cream cheese and added in a whole chopped onion for more flavor. I missed the butter part, but I don't think it needed it anyway. My breast were still frozen when I started this, took 7 hours to cook on low. We served over white rice. The kids were over and liked it so much they're taking home the leftovers.

I blended the chipotle peppers with the cream of chicken before tossing in over the chicken. I also didn’t have any chicken broth, so I opted that ingredient out, plus I was using chicken thighs instead of breast which turned out just perfect! The whole family loved it. Even my pickiest eater. It’s definitely a family favorite!

I make this all the time with no alterations to the ingredients. I shred the chicken when it's finished and serve over rice, which nearly doubles the amount served and probably helps with the dryness that some others are experiencing. Top with shredded cheese and sour cream.

We all loved it. I had to use chicken legs since that is what I had in the freezer. I omitted the butter and then mixed all the sauce ingredients in a bowl, microwaved 45 seconds, stirred 'til smooth and poured over the chicken in the slow cooker. I added an additional pepper since we like a lot of heat. Definitely will make again.

YUM! This is simplicity at it's best - several basic pantry ingredients and a little ingenuity combine to create a star quality (and easy!) dish. I didn't think for a moment that this would be as flavorful as it was. Joking aside, I could literally drink the sauce (it was THAT good). Other than using only 3 chicken breasts (all I had), adding half of a (small) minced onion and cooking everything on high for 3 hours (ran out of time...), I pretty much followed tnahinu's directions to the letter. TIP: You only need to slightly soften your cream cheese to avoid an unsightly lumpy sauce. It's not necessary to melt your cream cheese completely OR on the stovetop. I briefly zapped mine in the microwave, added the remaining ingredients (including onion) and stirred. A few tiny lumps remained, but they were small enough to melt completely during the cooking process. The result was a velvety smooth, SUPER flavorful sauce. Rice was the perfect complement to serve with our chicken (and was divine topped with the delicious sauce!). Steamed broccoli rounded out our meal. Thanks SO much for sharing your awesome recipe, tnahinu. This was the BOMB! :-)

The recipe was great but a bit spicy - I live in the southwest and like spicy foods. It was too spicy for my kids but my husband and I loved it. To tone it down a bit next time, I guess I would use less pepper or adobe sauce and/or dilute a little with more chicken broth or water. I have cooked with chipotle peppers before and I thought they were mild and have eaten chipotle salsa - also which is mild so maybe I just stumbled upon some hotter ones. Still a good recipe to try again! Been making since 2014!
It's one of my all time favorite recipe.

Been making this recipe for years and it is a family favorite. I shred the chicken and serve it over egg noodles with green beans (kids like to mix them), but it's also good with rice. HINT: For those who don't like it spicy, add a dollop of sour cream to the serving to cut the heat.
My favorite chicken recipe!
This was exactly what I was looking for!! I have a can of Chipotle and wanted to find something easy and tasty!! All Recipes always comes through!! Thanks

I stuck to the recipe but had left over adobo sauce that needed to be used so I used more than this recipe called for and it came out spicey spicey. It tasted great. To tone it down for my husband, i added some sour cream to it and put it over a bed of rice.. very tasty.
Other than the overpowering taste of the cream of chicken soup there was not much flavor, even with adding extra chipotles. Nobody in the family liked it.
I made this according to the recipe and it was delicious My husband made a side of tex mex rice that went with it perfectly.

This was so good. I doubled the sauce and I’m glad I did. My husband had it over his eggs this morning and requested it in tacos tonight! He never admits to liking anything! Plus I was able to use the whole can f chipotle, sauce and all. We like things spicy but not ridiculous and this was perfect. Thanks for the recipe
